title: Roast my trading lab. It grades your strategy honestly and my own bots are down $402k
author: QuanTradin
selftext:
https://preview.redd.it/1wqs4s07rsmh1.png?width=1200&format=png&auto=webp&s=976144f58073fafb58113955953679f6cf568464

Built a backtesting engine that refuses to flatter you. Buys at the ask, sells at the bid, never the midpoint, never sees tomorrow, and scores everything on a slice of history the strategy was never tuned on.

You write the rule in plain English, it grades it, and then you can run it on a paper desk with $100k of pretend money. Free, no card. An AI agent can run the desk too if you want, over MCP.The reason I'm posting rather than quietly launching: I ran 249 of my own bots through it and they are down $401,996. Two of the seven strategies everyone teaches grade negative. I publish both of those numbers on the [site.So](http://site.So) the honest question is whether "we'll tell you your idea is bad" is a product anyone wants, or whether I've spent months building something that only I find interesting.

quantradin.com. Tear into it.

comments.author: Sweaty-Regret559
comments.body: Mannnnn anyone with any experience is going to run their own backtest/paper trading, and i really dont think anyone with a strategy and edge is going to just insert it into some random website, maybe thats just me though

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: i mean still you need to test it with market data in real time right

replies.author: Sweaty-Regret559
replies.body: If your saying that you pay for market data and offer the service for free that might change things a bit, i guess the next question is what data is available on your site?

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: full live market data for testing all strategies people have

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: US stocks and single leg options. Free tier is 20 symbols on daily bars, 10 runs a month, one paper desk. Intraday from 1 minute up is on the paid tier, which nobody is charged for right now. Options fill at the real bid and ask where a quote exists, modeled spread before that, and it's labeled.

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: Probably right for anyone with a working edge. It's for the person who doesn't have their own backtester yet, not the one who does.

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: Probably right for anyone with a real edge. The people it's for don't have a backtester at all yet and are about to trust a chart someone posted. That's who I built it for, not you.

comments.author: shitti_kitti
comments.body: So are you just hoping no one asks if you have access and ability to filter and copy winning strategies?

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: Technically I can, it's my database. So don't paste in the edge you'd never share. It's built for the person who doesn't have their own backtester yet, not the one guarding a working one.

replies.author: shitti_kitti
replies.body:
But you built a public backtester and are expecting people to test strategies. 

How do they guard a working strategy if they are coming to you to test their strategies? No one backtests live working strategies, they test the unknown.

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body:
The unknown is the point. You bring the idea you're not sure about, the engine tells you if it's junk, most of them are. Anything that grades well you take home and run yourself.

I'm not a custodian for edges. I'm the place you find out you don't have one.

replies.author: shitti_kitti
replies.body:
But if it grades well, you know that and know the strategy.

You can dress it up all you want. If anyone puts a winning strategy through this, you know what it is and can reproduce it.

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: It sits in our own database. I can see it as the admin, nobody else can, and it isn't shared or sold. Same deal as any hosted tool, so don't put in the thing you'd never show anyone.

comments.author: johnnybagofdonuts123
comments.body: If by you built, you mean Claude did, sure.

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: yeah it is what it is

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: With a lot of help, yes. The grading engine is the bit worth roasting, it handed my own strategies mostly SHADOW.
